value.rationale: The distinction between endogenous mutation and competition after exogenous seeding is central to what the model can scientifically represent. The article explicitly frames Section 4 as mutation-generated variant onset and uses the model to discuss replacement and deaths, yet the printed vector field cannot create any variant from variant-free data. Identifying the invariant face gives an exact, model-structural boundary and a reproducibility condition for future extensions, rather than a cosmetic notation issue.
